storyTitle: Monorepo scaffold with server and client workspaces
description: As a developer, I need a monorepo layout with server and client workspaces so that subsequent stories can build on a consistent structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json declares workspaces for app/server and app/client
app/server has tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript and Express + TypeScript dependencies
app/client has tsconfig.json and Vite + React dependencies
Vite config in app/client proxies /api/* to http://localhost:3000
npm test script is wired at the root (can be a placeholder until US-006)
All code lives under app/ (Marmite convention)
guidance: This is the first story — establish the monorepo foundation. Key points: (1) Root package.json must declare workspaces pointing to app/server and app/client. (2) app/server needs Express and @types/express with strict TypeScript config. (3) app/client needs Vite + React with a vite.config.ts that proxies /api/* to http://localhost:3000. (4) A root-level npm test script must exist (placeholder is fine). (5) All source lives under app/. Run tsc --noEmit to confirm typecheck passes across both workspaces. Sensor configs have been installed at app/.dependency-cruiser.json and app/.eslintrc.json for future iterations.
reasoning: US-001 is the highest-priority story (priority 1) and all stories are currently failing. No prior iteration context exists, so sensors were skipped for this first run.
